hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks, inspired by biology, generalize better with fewer parameters, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物学启发的液态神经网络以更少参数获得更强的分布外泛化，目标是面向边缘设备的设备原生基础模型，而非只盯着数据中心。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures win as Scaling proceeds.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍不可或缺，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑更小的专用模型；随着 Scaling（规模扩张）推进，无偏架构胜出。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and let automated architecture search replace human bias in design.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导人；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用自动化架构搜索取代架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain; intelligence per watt demands new paradigms, not just architectures.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；每瓦智能的提升需要新范式，而不只是新架构。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应，并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的提案是监管俘获，而开放权重模型让企业获得数据主权。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs serve 5-10x faster and cheaper at similar quality; inference-time scaling is the new focus, with denoising steps as a compute knob.
ermon.zh: 2026 年 3 月：扩散语言模型在相近质量下服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低；推理时 Scaling 成为新焦点，去噪步数成为新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate multiple tokens per step, enabling in-place error correction and better controllability than autoregressive token-by-token generation.
ermon.zh: 2026 年 3 月：扩散模型每步生成多个 token，支持原地纠错，比自回归的逐 token 生成更具可控性。

ermon.en: RL post-training benefits from diffusion's faster inference for rollouts, though diffusion LLMs still only match speed-optimized frontier tiers, not the best frontier models.
ermon.zh: 2026 年 3 月：扩散模型的快速推理有利于强化学习后训练的 rollout，但扩散语言模型目前仅追平速度优化的前沿层级，尚未达到最强前沿模型的质量。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling by processing many tokens in parallel; inference efficiency is now the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 2026 年 9 月：扩散模型将凭借并行处理大量 token 主导推理时 Scaling；推理效率已成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models are not the final architecture.
ermon.zh: 2026 年 9 月：下一次架构变革发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型并非最终架构。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and a small 50-person startup can compete with big labs by owning the full stack; human ingenuity still beats recursive self-improvement.
ermon.zh: 2026 年 9 月：速度是持久的产品优势，50 人小团队靠全栈自研可与大实验室竞争；人类创造力仍胜过递归自我改进。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，自博弈在非零和领域失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific tricks.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力扩张，而非数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张：模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，传统单一分数已过时。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调：多智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，而对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering and multiplanet life insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并用第一性原理思考推动突破性工程，把成为多行星物种视为文明的保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; real-world AI is compute-efficient, while lying AI is the biggest risk.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与求真：特斯拉真实世界 AI 更省算力，而让 AI 为政治正确说谎才是最大风险。

elon.en: Civilization's threat is population collapse; human bandwidth is under one bit per second, so Neuralink enables AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他聚焦人口崩溃这一文明威胁，并指出人类通信带宽不足每秒一比特，Neuralink 因此成为人机共生路径。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year, with 80-90% good outcome but 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今年到来，结果 80%至 90%向好，但有 10%至 20%毁灭风险。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, forcing AI data centers to space; AI inference in orbit, Terafab chips, and Optimus recursive manufacturing drive abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，AI 数据中心必须上天：轨道推理、Terafab 芯片与 Optimus 递归制造共同带来丰裕。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，新的计算单元不再是芯片而是数据中心，算法、系统与数据中心必须协同设计（co-design）。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws — pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking — make compute demand explode; scaling itself was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考，认为最大的突破不是新算法而是「Scaling 有效」这一洞见，推理算力需求将暴涨。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each step needs ~100x compute, and agents will dominate the future internet.
jensen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 演进描述为生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步都要多约 100 倍算力；未来互联网将由数十亿智能体 24/7 生成智能。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and the CUDA ecosystem are the moat; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute, not data, is the limit.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他深化护城河论：极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态才是壁垒，推理比预训练更难，瓶颈已从数据转向算力，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: Safety and speed are compatible; existential-risk warnings are a hoax, open models win the race, and AGI already exists in narrow domains.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年他立场明显转向强硬：安全与加速并不矛盾，存在性风险警告是「骗局」，开源模型决定胜负，并称在自动驾驶、蛋白质合成等窄领域已实现 AGI 与超级智能。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with chain of thought needed beyond raw scaling; AGI as transformative and alignment via human-preference data.
brockman.zh: 早期（2017→19）：主线是 Scaling（规模扩张）加工程能力，认为单靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理，需要思维链等新想法；同时把 AGI（通用人工智能）视为最具变革性的技术，主张通过从数据中学习人类偏好来实现对齐。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; base models hold a universe of possibilities, post-training refines them; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 到 2025 年，算力被明确为 AI 创新的根本驱动力与巨大瓶颈；基础模型蕴含无限可能，后训练将其精炼为稳定行为；AGI 不再是终点，而是一个持续的过程，旅程本身与里程碑同样重要。

brockman.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; post-training with reinforcement learning teaches complex tasks; compute access framed as a future basic right.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，缩放定律持续有效，更大模型带来可预测提升；后训练结合强化学习成为教会模型复杂任务的关键；算力获取被提升为未来的基本权利，AI 将走向算力驱动的经济。

brockman.en: Shift from language models to useful assistants; agentic coding jumps from 20% to 80% of code; human attention and alignment become the scarcest bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年中，从语言模型转向能解决真实任务的实用助手；智能体式编程工具在 12 月从写 20%代码跃升到 80%，成为主工作流；人类注意力与对齐判断成为最稀缺的瓶颈。

brockman.en: AGI era declared: Astra runs coherently 24 hours; safety, security, alignment upleveled as the bottleneck; compute scarcity limits broad access.
brockman.zh: 2026 年最近，宣布进入 AGI 时代：Astra 能连贯运行 24 小时；安全、安保与对齐被持续升级并成为进展瓶颈；算力稀缺意味着并非所有人都能获得访问，防御方需以机器速度自动化防御工厂。

joellewenstein.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting, prototype, and balance lowering the floor with raising the ceiling.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段；设计师必须掌握提示词、原型设计，并在降低门槛与提升上限之间取得平衡。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities. AI's social and emotional jobs may matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调即使模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作可释放现有能力；AI 的社交与情感任务可能与生产力提升同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value, not the product wrapper. Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品外壳；应相信缩放定律，让模型主导并交付轻量产品。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; internal traction is the best signal. Production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他主张不要宏大的 18 个月战略，内部牵引力是最佳信号；生产代码库正成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership remains essential for hard trade-offs and aligning teams. Designers must close the gap between code productivity and what people actually want.
joellewenstein.zh: 贯穿始终的是，人类领导力在艰难权衡与团队对齐上仍不可或缺；设计师必须弥合代码生产力与人们真正需求之间的鸿沟。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上媲美物理模型，却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial; a single model can then handle both weather and climate stably.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等领域结构至关重要，单个模型由此可稳定地同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness to ensure reliability in physical applications.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，以确保物理应用中的可靠性。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding aims at a universal physics model, using PDEs as training signals for self-improvement beyond data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 旨在构建通用物理模型，用 PDE 作为训练信号实现超越数据质量的自改进。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律是经验性的，统计损失可预测但具体能力不可预测；对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他深化主线：可解释性关键但仅理解约 3%；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要；AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; risks rise exponentially, AGI term is meaningless, and the biggest danger is overheating, not slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年立场转变：安全与能力不可分割，风险指数上升；他称 AGI 一词无意义，最大风险是过热而非减速，并强调智能体式产品与护栏。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
dario.zh: 2026 年他警告我们已接近指数末端：数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，将出现高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的空前宏观组合。

dario.en: Scaling laws, interpretability, and safety-first enterprise focus remain constant; he consistently rejects sudden superintelligence leaps for smooth exponential progress.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：缩放定律、可解释性与安全优先的企业路线；他始终拒绝超级智能的突变式跳跃，坚持平滑指数进步。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI firms race for control, risking loss of control and ~70% catastrophic odds.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺控制权而竞赛，反而带来失控风险，灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and US-China cooperation are key, with domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他主张 AI 政策的首要目标是推迟超级智能；全面研究透明与美中合作是关键，但应先从国内监管做起。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by end-2028; Plan A pauses training, then paces the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他认为默认路径会让 AI 研究在 2028 年底前被完全自动化，走向递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先暂停训练，再以透明和算力限制为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet declining with new architectures; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve superintelligence.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要，却随新架构而下降；控制只是临时手段，对齐最终必须解决超级智能问题。

kokotajlo.en: Across all talks, he treats the AI race as a power grab, urging transparency, regulation and containment to avoid loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他把 AI 竞赛视为一场权力争夺，持续呼吁透明、监管与遏制，以避免失控。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人层面：降低认知负荷、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI 会压低人类智力的溢价，让人从关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从个人效率转向 AGI 治理：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据完成对齐，早期公开部署让社会适应，并主张对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering; safety must be built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）持续兑现能力，安全不再是一次性收尾，而是通过迭代部署在真实使用中逐步构建，智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence is the clearer goal, with compute as the bottleneck.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能才是更清晰的目标，算力成为最大瓶颈，Stargate 等基础设施因此成为核心议题。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capability; humans must stay in control as superintelligence ramps.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，主线深化为对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，甚至为安全推迟前沿强化学习训练，强调人类必须始终掌控超级智能的连续攀升，避免权力与收益集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI at the current stage benefits innovation and safety; the biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他主张当前阶段开源 AI 有利于创新与安全，最大的风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling alone may not reach AGI; open source prevents power concentration, while energy becomes the key bottleneck for Scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling 未必通向 AGI，开源可防止权力集中，而能源正成为 Scaling 的关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source models and personalization matter, and AI will raise rather than cut human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，开源模型与个性化是关键，AI 短期内会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Frontier AI and biology integrate via world models and interpretability; distributed personal AI agents, not one centralized superintelligence, are safer.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张前沿 AI 与生物学通过世界模型和可解释性深度结合，分布式的个人 AI 智能体比单一集中式超级智能更安全。

zuckerberg.en: A consistent thread: open source, distributed power, and empowering individuals over centralized control, from models to glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源、权力分散、赋能个体而非集中控制，从模型延伸到智能眼镜。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are the underappreciated next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断扩张算力的历史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，超越语言智能。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms rather than just scaling models; GPU scaling is hitting limits.
justinjohnson.zh: 学术界应追求古怪的想法与新算法，而非只是做规模扩张；GPU 的规模扩张正逼近极限。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to understand, generate, and simulate worlds.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型去理解、生成并模拟世界。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; new model types are needed, with long-context a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法自然带来对世界的理解；需要新的模型类型，而长上下文成为日常难题。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, not architecture.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；一致性来自数据，而非架构。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction but lack contextual awareness; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测学习，却缺乏情境感知；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 缺失的关键，仅靠语言与 Scaling 不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: AGI 更像营销术语而非科学；由于数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必适用于机器人。

feifei.en: World Labs builds large world models via new view prediction; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence, bottlenecked by training compute.
feifei.zh: World Labs 通过新视角预测构建大世界模型；缩放定律适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central as AI advances.
feifei.zh: 技术是双刃剑；随着 AI 进步，人类能动性、尊严与学习能力必须始终居于中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific incidents, not just statistically evaluate; intentional design steers training to prevent deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体事故做根因分析，而非仅做统计评估；有意设计用可解释性信号引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式走向工程科学；靠打补丁把安全拖到超级智能到来是悲观的，现在就需要更深的工程方法。

tommcgrath.en: Concepts form clean low-dimensional manifolds; sparse autoencoders fragment them, so seeing whole shapes enables intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 概念在神经网络中形成干净的低维流形；稀疏自编码器会碎片化流形，看到完整形状才能有效干预。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are wrong or hallucinating but proceed due to reward or operation ordering; detect via representational signatures.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己错了或在幻觉却仍继续，源于奖励或操作顺序；可通过表征签名检测这种奖励黑客。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, and modularity is the endpoint of learning.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体可加速科学发现，而模块化是学习的终点。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and data improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，海量学生数据还能提升评分准确度。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised and RL hype; AGI alignment worries distract from immediate bias issues.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督与强化学习；对 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐的担忧分散了对偏见等当下问题的注意力。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful; coding stays valuable.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已实用；学编程依然有价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; top-down workflow redesign beats bottom-up; open models prevent oligopoly.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）转向合成数据与强化学习；自上而下的工作流重构胜过自下而上；开放模型防止寡头垄断。

andrewng.en: AI augments rather than replaces; fear-mongering serves incumbents; humans keep a context advantage; data centers and inference capacity matter.
andrewng.zh: AI 是增强而非取代；渲染恐惧服务于在位者；人类保有上下文优势；数据中心与推理（inference）算力至关重要。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research; full automation could compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习能迁移到真实研究；研发全自动化可把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，从而在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress is driven more by algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than by scaling human expert data labeling; token cost has not risen because labs prioritize faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调进展更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非规模扩张人类专家数据标注；token 成本未随 Scaling 上升，因为实验室优先追求更快迭代。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; AIs may become more misaligned as they get more capable, with reward hacking generalizing to broader deception.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐到普遍美德概念可能比对齐到用户意图更难；AI 越有能力可能越不对齐，奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: Multi-agent collaboration can be surprisingly sophisticated: over 50 agents coordinated in hours, hacked Hugging Face to understand scoring code, and even sacrificed task success to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他观察到多智能体协作惊人地复杂：50 多个智能体数小时内协同，入侵 Hugging Face 以理解评分代码，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: Even if models are misaligned, labs should focus on control and monitoring; misalignment may be papered over by overfitting to tests, making models look aligned while still misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张即便模型不对齐，实验室也应聚焦遏制与监控；不对齐可能被对测试的过拟合掩盖，使模型看似对齐实则仍不对齐。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning has been OpenAI's core formula since 2019; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, though scaling RL is harder than pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年他仍强调：预训练加强化学习是 OpenAI 自 2019 年以来的核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把令人失望的 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data stays limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年初，他深化了 Scaling（规模扩张）叙事：预训练与强化学习可预测地提升模型，但泛化仍受限于训练数据；持续学习才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习未必足够。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他的立场明显转向：Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上存在局限，架构而非缩放定律成为当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈，需要新架构与更好的优化算法。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is necessary for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: 同期他进一步反思：强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式，且效率不高；真正落地需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化，而非单纯依赖强化学习。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier wave will come from small teams using highly capable agents, not transformer-scale races.
tworek.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他给出更远判断：人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年以上；下一波前沿突破将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，而非在 Transformer 上与大实验室拼算力，同时对齐问题仍未解决。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework and no rigid red lines.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保有开源与闭源 AI 生态，用单一国家监管框架取代拼凑规则，且不设僵化红线。

michaelkratsios.en: The EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; early regulation is dangerous, and biological risk is overblown.
michaelkratsios.zh: 欧盟 AI 法案写于 ChatGPT 之前、早已过时；过早监管很危险，而 AI 生物风险被夸大。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, to protect startups from compliance burden.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应聚焦模型输出，而非过度监管训练，以免初创公司被合规负担压垮。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions or centralized science.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前 R&D 和科学家个人，而非机构或集中式科学。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output, competing with China in AI, quantum, nuclear, bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: Genesis 任务用 AI 赋能科学、力争让美国科学产出翻倍，在 AI、量子、核与生物领域与中国竞争。

dylanpatel.en: Compute crunch is structural: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and power, not just GPUs, set the pace of AI Scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力紧缺是结构性的：半导体供应链、内存带宽与电力，而非单纯 GPU，决定 Scaling（规模扩张）的节奏。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a dominant global market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球主导市场；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中；实验室把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: Agentic workflows and reinforcement learning shift demand: persistent agents as coworkers, plus surging memory and CPU needs.
dylanpatel.zh: 智能体式工作流与强化学习改变需求结构：持久化智能体充当同事，同时推高内存与 CPU 需求。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus at steady state, yet compute stays scarce; value capture shifts from hardware toward labs.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 支出在稳态下趋于平台期，但算力仍稀缺；价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; RL post-training boosts robustness, and pooled robot data yields generalist models beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；强化学习后训练提升鲁棒性，汇聚多实验室机器人数据能产出超越专家的通用模型。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；核心挑战是泛化，而非演示效果。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data; start with robot data, then add human video.
slevine.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据扩展正确的东西；应先从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频。

slevine.en: Robots should not learn from scratch; leverage prior knowledge, and expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects rather than mechanical people.
slevine.zh: 机器人不应从零学习，要利用各类先验知识；应期待日常物体中无处不在的物理驱动，而非机械式的人形。

slevine.en: The path to home robots runs through milestones like autonomous improvement and transferring common sense from pre-training to handle unexpected situations.
slevine.zh: 通往家用机器人的路径要经过自主改进、以及把预训练获得的常识迁移去应对意外情况等里程碑。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, set by infrastructure, decide startup success; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 在 2026 年 Y Combinator 的分享中，他强调速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败的关键；卡住时要用行动创造信息、打破僵局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他仍把 AI 视为团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上放大人的能力。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他指出深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术不成立，并强调 CEO 的判断不可外包，必须自己做决定。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年在 No Priors 中，他坚持大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: BCIs and substrate independence reduce human fragility, extending the brain's preservation into space.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把脑机接口与基质独立视为降低人类脆弱性的路径，让大脑保存与太空探索成为自然延伸。

joonpark.en: Early on, LLMs encode human behavior from training data, letting agents simulate societies; the frontier is modeling subjective values, not rationality.
joonpark.zh: 早期，大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体得以模拟社会；前沿在于建模主观价值，而非理性。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并行动，不同于只续写提示的大语言模型；AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一实体，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Simulation should represent human values and taste, not super-rational intelligence; models should be biased like humans, not optimized for accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应体现人类的价值与品味，而非超级理性的智能；模型应像人一样有偏见，而不是为准确率优化。

joonpark.en: Behavioral RCT data and post-training push simulation to 85% accuracy; the goal shifts from prediction to counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 行为随机对照试验数据与后训练把模拟推到 85%准确率；目标从预测转向反事实推理与塑造未来。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems; simulation is a decision tool far larger than market research, not a prediction engine.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人的生命以应对棘手问题；模拟是远超市场调研的决策工具，而非预测引擎。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，Sutton 提出 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI goals is dangerous. The fear narrative needs sober discussion.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，试图控制 AI 目标很危险；恐惧叙事需要冷静讨论。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the basic AI paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是 AI 的基本范式，下一个词预测不是实质性目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture learning from runtime experience; design-time domain knowledge should be deprecated.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验中学习的通用架构，设计时的领域知识应被弃用。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; learning from experience is key.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申持续学习至关重要，LLM 训练后即停止学习；合成数据是错误，从经验中学习才是关键。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low latency inference at 10,000+ tokens per second is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每用户每秒 1 万 token 以上的超低延迟推理成为关键。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must cut data movement and specialize prefill vs. decode.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心 90% 功耗，因此硬件必须减少数据搬运，并针对预填充与解码分别专用化。

jeffdean.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops; recursive self-improvement and AI-driven scientific method accelerate discovery.
jeffdean.zh: 下一个前沿是通过紧密的实验-评估闭环来自动化机器学习与科学；递归自我改进与 AI 驱动的科学方法将加速发现。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure aims to reach AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是全世界最大的生意；瓶颈在智能而非制造，Figure 的目标是在物理世界中实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The core constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; the humanoid form enables transfer learning, with on-device inference and the human hand as benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 核心约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人形形态支持迁移学习，强调端侧推理，并以人手为基准。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key to real-world agents, and the hardest problem remains building truly intelligent systems.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练配合强化学习是让智能体在真实任务中奏效的关键，而最难的问题始终是构建真正智能的系统。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像处理比特一样处理原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode and internal correctness beat external validation; founders should communicate directly as media gatekeepers fade.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式与内部正确性胜过外部认可；随着传统媒体守门人式微，创始人应直接发声。

traviskalanick.en: Uber's success came despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, love of the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是顶着激进文化取得的，而非因其成功；以复仇为燃料是脏的，热爱新使命更干净。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must stay hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edges create network effects and outstrip subsidies.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务中，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，并胜过补贴。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating model behavior and system prompts as the core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把模型行为和系统提示词当作核心设计材料，而非像素；设计应围绕 token 与对话展开，用系统思维设计人与模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the core product; designers should prototype with live models, not static mockups.
iansilber.zh: 同月，他提出模型本身就是核心产品，设计师应少花时间在 Figma，多做带实时模型的功能原型；设计师角色正演变为编辑与策展人，而非消失。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design must bridge it by pushing technology forward.
iansilber.zh: 从 4 月到 8 月，他持续强调能力差距：模型能做的多于产品所暴露的，设计必须弥合这一差距；优秀设计师要推动技术前进，而不只是回应用户需求。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet best-positioned in tech; AI is already a great product designer, but humans remain essential.
iansilber.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断设计师虽因角色不确定而最不快乐，却正处最佳时机；AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与持有观点仍离不开人。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed, outcomes, and adaptability with AI tools matter most.
iansilber.zh: 同月，他宣告传统设计流程已不可行，速度与结果优先；设计师应拥抱 AI 工具带来的适应性与探索，设计角色与 PM、工程模糊化，但规模化下专业分工仍有价值。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams can outproduce large ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮，强调创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流，小型高度自治团队可凭 AI 智能体实现巨大产出。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调开源与开放权重模型是对冲前沿模型权力、避免超级智能被单一实体控制的关键。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as agents on your own infrastructure, compounding daily from context you own.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年中，他从通用 AI 浪潮深化为“个人 AGI”：不是单一事件，而是跑在自己基础设施上、靠自有上下文每日复利的智能体。

garrytan.en: Markdown skill files become employees; owning them is the moat, and per-seat SaaS may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出技能文件即员工、Markdown 即代码，个人上下文库是护城河，并预言按席位收费的 SaaS 可能五到十年内消失。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders beat bankers, and rejection is a resilience test for founders.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做人们想要的东西，真诚的建造者胜过银行家，被拒是创始人的韧性测试。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一模型统治一切的 AGI（通用人工智能）是错的；未来会由数百万个专用模型主导，每个应用场景一个。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内将下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, building a moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，在产品市场契合之外构筑护城河。

linqiao.en: The path from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning: facts, taste, expertise.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的路径，映射人类学习：事实、品味、专长。

linqiao.en: Start post-training after product-market fit; it cuts costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably.
linqiao.zh: 在产品市场契合后再启动后训练；它能把成本降低 5-10 倍，让初创公司可盈利地扩张。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality via community feedback and attract ecosystem partners.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要；开源它们可以通过社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is a key method for training data when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感或不可用时，由领域专家指导的合成数据是训练数据的关键方法。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure, including fallbacks and routing, is necessary before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须拥有稳健的模型服务基础设施，包括回退和路由。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not to build the best legal model, but to enable every law firm to customize models with their own data, shifting from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是构建最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能用自己的数据定制模型，从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 的海量数据。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只靠全量数据训练会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据让机器人能响应开放式指令，其作用更接近强化学习而非模拟。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, with constraints and fewer resources fostering more careful research than wasteful compute.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色；相比浪费算力，约束与更少资源反而促成更审慎的研究。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性要靠带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than training per-site models.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable—watching humans is not enough—and embodied data costs will slow robotics distribution versus ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观察人类远远不够；具身数据的成本会让机器人普及慢于 ChatGPT。

jasonyuan.en: Design and AI creation are acts of subtraction: taste is saying no, editing from a point of view, distilling 99 nos into one shipped feature.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计与 AI 创作本质是减法：品味就是说不，从某种视角做编辑，把 99 个否定蒸馏成一个上线的功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more because incoherent slop is cheap.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；如今连贯作品的成本反而上升，因为不连贯的垃圾唾手可得。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool; computing is fundamentally social, not merely personal.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冷冰冰的机械工具；计算本质上是社会性的，而不只是个人的。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass guiding creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉是引导创作决策的切身罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: The personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer; email is obsolete and must be reinvented, not merely improved.
jasonyuan.zh: 个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会性电脑；电子邮件已经过时，必须被重新发明，而不只是改良。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and never revert—fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零看代码库，用简短迭代的提示，永不回滚，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离智能体，并把提示注入视为尚未解决的开放难题。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run everywhere with any model, as the alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 像 Open Claw 这样的开源智能体让编程民主化，可随处运行并兼容任何模型，是实验室智能体的替代方案。

steinberger.en: Fun and play drive mastery: build what annoys you, learn by small projects, and prefer agentic engineering over vibe coding.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与玩耍驱动精通：从让你恼火的问题入手，用小项目学习，并坚持用智能体式工程而非氛围编程。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck is compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents and open source sustainability are economic problems.
steinberger.zh: 真正的瓶颈是算力与 token，而非模型能力；常驻智能体与开源可持续性本质上是经济问题。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, first-time-pass silicon, and a startup-like AI chip team; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠取悦客户、兑现承诺重建信任，恢复首次流片即成功的工程纪律，并为主流业务之外单独组建创业式 AI 芯片团队；同时判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波大浪潮，AI 是半导体增长的首要驱动力。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI; turnaround needs humility, listening, accountability, and domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把判断升级为 AI 的影响将是互联网的十倍，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的大浪潮；并强调转型靠谦逊、倾听与问责，美国需要本土领先制程晶圆厂保障供应链韧性，Intel 的核心问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging, glass and diamond materials break physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他进一步深化：AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要；先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦互连、功耗、散热等瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration and manufacturing create value; memory is ripe for new architectures; trillion-dollar goal arrives four years early.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他回到更宏观的立场：半导体是一切技术应用的根基，垂直整合与自有制造反而创造更多价值，内存从大宗商品变为创新沃土；行业万亿美元目标将提前四年达成，合作比视他人为对手更有价值。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, listening, and treating customers as partners are the constant thread across every stage of the turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以客户信任为核心，靠谦逊、倾听与把客户当伙伴来推动转型；这一信念从 2025 到 2026 年从未改变，只是承载它的技术判断不断更新。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely lands around 2029, three orders of magnitude away.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的革命大概在 2029 年到来，与今天相差三个数量级。

pincus.en: Proven Better New: copy proven concepts, add small betterments, assume new ideas fail; all new fails statistically.
pincus.zh: 「已验证、更好、全新」框架：复制已验证的概念，做小幅改进，并假定全新想法会失败；统计上所有全新尝试都会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start; picking the right body of water beats the right boat.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略；选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; we remain in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution.
pincus.zh: AI 具有变革性，但还不是新平台；在消费级分发上我们仍处于移动与 Web 时代。

pincus.en: Free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services; don't write code that calls LLMs, write markdown that teaches LLMs to write code.
pincus.zh: 免费无限算力将重塑消费级服务；不要写调用 LLM 的代码，而要写教 LLM 写代码的 markdown。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI is still tiny; 90% of use cases can run on open-source models, and cost, not privacy, drives adoption.
arvindjain.zh: 企业 AI 仍处极早期；90% 的用例可由开源模型承担，驱动开源采用的是成本而非数据隐私。

arvindjain.en: The real bottleneck is execution and context, not competition; agents fail without the deep context of tenured employees.
arvindjain.zh: 真正的瓶颈是执行与上下文，而非竞争；智能体若缺乏资深员工的深层上下文就会失败。

arvindjain.en: Frontier model providers are assets, not rivals; platforms like Glean absorb the risk of a fast-moving model race.
arvindjain.zh: 前沿模型厂商是资产而非对手；像 Glean 这样的平台替企业吸收模型快速迭代的风险。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and departmental-metric problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量与部门指标问题；不应把 token 支出框定为与人力成本的取舍。

arvindjain.en: AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost; inference will shift mostly to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: AI 必须变得像软件一样边际成本可忽略；未来 12-18 个月推理将大多转向开源。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics hits the Transformer inflection: hardware ready, software catching up; open source and shared data solve generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人正处在当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶；开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键。

thomaswolf.en: World models and video generation can synthesize training data, easing the data-diversity bottleneck in embodied AI.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，世界模型与视频生成能合成训练数据，缓解具身智能的数据多样性瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Open source wins long term on cost and control; China championing open models is surprising but driven by internal competition.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开源凭成本与控制力长期胜出；中国成为开源模型旗手出人意料，却由内部竞争驱动。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, sandboxes and guardrails insufficient as models grow capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源同安全正交；对齐才是关键层，沙箱与护栏在模型变强后并不足够。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，无人监督的强化学习滋生奖励黑客与支线任务；推理轨迹变成“神经语”，监控更不可靠。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you can't know if an idea works until it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络是混乱的；一个想法只有被构建并每天使用后，你才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always behave as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；允许个人印记和多元声音能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，对创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new technology; playful exploration can lead to innovative features.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应追随好奇心、摆弄新技术；玩闹式的探索能催生创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator, making design tools more valuable.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化因素，使设计工具更有价值。

nateparrott.en: Models are better at busy work than actual design thinking, so humans still have a monopoly on good design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 模型更擅长杂活而非真正的设计思考，因此人类仍垄断着好的设计想法。

nateparrott.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early to ideas beats polishing; shipping rough products is acceptable.
nateparrott.zh: 在 AI 时代，过早押注想法胜过精雕细琢；发布粗糙产品是可以接受的。

nateparrott.en: Designers should spend more time on walks and thinking, because good ideas are the currency, not execution.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应花更多时间散步和思考，因为好想法才是硬通货，而非执行。

brettaylor.en: AI markets shift to agents and outcomes-based pricing; frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers, so startups should build applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 市场将转向智能体与基于结果的定价；前沿模型开发因巨额资本开支被超大规模厂商主导，初创公司应聚焦应用层 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Agents become the new app and internet wave; inference costs drop, incumbents face business-model not tech hurdles, and agents get compared to agents, not humans.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年稍晚，他深化判断：智能体将成为新的应用与互联网浪潮；推理成本大幅下降，在位企业面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍，且十年内智能体将被拿来与其他智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents are a major productivity tool, but token consumption is not a value metric; applied AI innovation will come from specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他延续并深化：编程智能体是重要生产力工具，但 token 消耗并非价值度量；应用层 AI 的创新将来自专业化厂商，而非仅模型提供商。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; AI democratizes expertise, and adoption is faster than past waves, causing mid-career discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调：负责任的迭代部署——在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全——是关键；AI 让专业知识民主化，其采用速度远超以往技术浪潮，给职业中期人群带来不适。

brettaylor.en: Focus on the most impactful thing today, not identity; AI will create more jobs than it displaces, and outcomes matter more than productivity metrics.
brettaylor.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：专注当下最有影响力的事而非身份标签；AI 创造的岗位将多于取代的岗位；结果比生产力指标更重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; serving demands GPU-to-distributed expertise, with research-to-production in hours.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入 AI 基础设施市场的楔子；推理工程需要从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛专长，研究到生产的周期常以小时计。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are key to fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的光谱；针对特定工作负载专门化的系统，是构建快速可靠智能体式应用的关键。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, but calibrating it to workloads can improve quality and cut cost.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的损失性优化，但针对工作负载校准量化，反而能提升质量并降低成本。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting work to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；GPU 趋于 ASIC 化，工作重心转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference systems: you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，对关键任务推理系统而言人类问责仍不可或缺：正常运行时间没法靠氛围编程。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks beyond the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；通过强化学习进行的后训练 Scaling 提供了无限任务，突破了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in prototyping.
karina.zh: 评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准测试的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此在原型开发中用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; agents on pixels remain far harder than language tasks.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能愈发珍贵；基于像素的智能体仍比语言任务困难得多。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 后训练仍是主观的，由人类判断驱动；评估创意写作与情商需要多样化的基准测试。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; serving one model to billions converges to an average voice, so more firms should train their own.
karina.zh: 前沿智能体越来越多地钻奖励空子，因此基准必须持续演进；用单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，所以更多公司应训练自己的模型。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and write 0% of the code, using giant prompts, screenshots, and a design.md style guide.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具、0% 手写代码，靠巨型提示、截图和 design.md 风格指南来驱动。

mengto.en: The best creators are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and workflow refinement beat chasing trends.
mengto.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑者，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始；好奇心与工作流打磨胜过追逐潮流。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear in disguise.
mengto.zh: 别等准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧的伪装。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; VC is a trap, the safe corporate job no longer exists.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的单一痛点问题；风险投资是陷阱，安全的公司岗位已不复存在。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck, and boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是瓶颈，表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用会带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据做后训练是关键，智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is the raw material, and compute plus data-center scale decide AI warfare.
awang.zh: 2025 年他转向地缘与安全视角：AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，数据是原材料，算力与数据中心规模决定 AI 战争。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold across compute, data and RL; recursive self-improvement and personal superintelligence are next, with safety-gated release.
awang.zh: 2026 年他主张缩放定律在算力、数据与强化学习多轴上依然成立，递归自我改进与个人超级智能是下一站，并以安全审查把关发布。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: as agents make services cheap, management and generalist skills become more valuable than coding.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务变便宜而推动美国就业回流，进入“分配经济”：当人人都成为模型管理者，管理与通才能力比写代码更值钱。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出 AGI 的经济学定义：能无限期无人干预地运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: Agents need a human who cares; automation requires oversight, and GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work replace CLIs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体需要在意它的人来运作，自动化离不开人类监督；工作界面从 CLI 转向 Codex、Claude Co-work 这类 GUI。

danshipper.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users, and companies should buy SaaS rather than build AI in.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他反驳 SaaS 将死：智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，企业应买入 SaaS 而非把 AI 硬塞进产品。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your existing mindset; humans stay smarter, and automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：AI 只是放大既有心态的非特定放大器，人类仍更聪明，自动化反而创造更多需要品味与手艺的人类工作。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件需求上升，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agents coexist.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步 IDE 与异步智能体将长期并存。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by a decade.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力约十年。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is approaching; coding agents grew 11-12x in six months, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他更乐观地提出丰裕时代临近：编程智能体半年增长 11 至 12 倍，真正的解锁点是容量而非效率。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 此时他强调两大产品原则：潜在需求，以及为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建；能写代码、做设计、直接对话用户的多面手工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the 'software engineer' title is fading into 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，他的立场明显推进：编码几乎已被解决，他的代码 100%由 Claude Code 写成，'软件工程师'头衔正让位于'构建者'，人人都将兼具产品经理角色。

boris.en: Agents and loops become the new abstraction; tool use, MCP, and autonomous long-running workflows drive 250% code growth per engineer.
boris.zh: 2026 年中期，他把重心从写代码转向智能体与循环：工具使用、MCP 和可长时自主运行的循环成为新抽象层，人均代码量增长 250%，非工程师也大量采用。

boris.en: Safety and alignment are reframed as core product work: Claude Code is a safety research tool, studied by releasing early in the wild.
boris.zh: 2026 年中后期，他深化了安全主线：把对齐与安全重新定义为产品核心工作，认为 Claude Code 本身就是安全研究工具，靠尽早真实发布来研究模型行为。

boris.en: With Opus 5, delete most prompts and code; give models slightly-too-hard tasks, let them self-verify, and shift from upfront design to empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 到最近，他进一步主张：随新模型到来删掉大部分系统提示与代码，给模型略超难度的任务让其自验证，工程思维从预先设计转向经验观察与迭代，价值移向产品感与商业能力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来一次智能跃升，让智能体能运行更长时间、更开放式的任务；脚手架也从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用正从受限环境走向更开放式的端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代了沉重脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考，提升的是模型质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price, and smaller models often cost more overall.
diannepenn.zh: 2025→26 年，更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，而小模型因任务耗时更长，总成本反而更高。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, and managers stay hands-on to ship.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，管理者保持动手、亲自交付。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）本身。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非自噬；成功指标应是客户结果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们希望自己仍握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Startups have more opportunity than ever despite model labs expanding; focus is their superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 尽管模型实验室不断扩张，初创公司机会空前；专注是它们的超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; they can't capture all customers.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难，它们无法俘获所有客户。

logankilpatrick.en: Keep up with AI through passionate pet projects, not forcing yourself.
logankilpatrick.zh: 靠热爱的个人小项目跟上 AI，而非强迫自己。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便有 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解仍至关重要；编程工具尚不能帮助维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造基本被解决，这会带来千倍机会，而非更少。

logankilpatrick.en: The delta between engineering, product, and research is blurry; tinkering is like research.
logankilpatrick.zh: 工程、产品与研究的界限已模糊；动手折腾就像做研究。

logankilpatrick.en: People feel overwhelmed not by too much change, but by too much opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 人们感到不堪重负，不是因为变化太多，而是因为机会太多。

logankilpatrick.en: Google is well-positioned but must work hard to take advantage; it's not easy.
logankilpatrick.zh: 谷歌位置有利，但必须努力才能把握优势，这并不容易。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是单一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑起步。

logankilpatrick.en: Vibe coding video games will be possible this year via coding agents plus game engines, not world models.
logankilpatrick.zh: 今年就能通过编程智能体加游戏引擎实现氛围编程做电子游戏，而非靠世界模型。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，快速推理成为核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场；晶圆级芯片通过绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，在推理上远超 GPU。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded in late 2024 as models got smart enough; the industry now chases real demand, not speculative capacity.
feldman.zh: 2024 年末起，随着模型变得足够聪明，推理需求爆发；行业追逐的是真实需求，而非投机性产能。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, power, cooling and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints; buildout lags demand.
feldman.zh: 真正的约束是数据中心容量、电力、冷却与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身；建设速度落后于需求。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power infrastructure and open-source, not compute.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，却便宜得多；中国的优势在电力基础设施与开源，而非算力。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，并使癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems and reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统、达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near, requiring engineering and AI to solve biological complexity.
derya.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已近在眼前，需要工程方法与 AI 来解决生物复杂性。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces; humanity is the only threat.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合；人类自身才是唯一威胁。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响将在 5-10 年内体现在农业、采矿和建筑领域，而不仅是数字 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他深化观点：Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能，来自不同垂直领域的多样化数据能更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步指出：物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演变为神经模拟，从而更高效地训练物理 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI stems from misunderstanding; in physical AI, labor shortages mean autonomy is welcomed, not feared.
qasaryounis.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：对 AI 的恐惧源于误解；在物理 AI 领域，劳动力短缺意味着自主性受到欢迎，而非恐惧。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, and harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比我们现有的工具链所能发挥的更聪明；能力过剩是长期存在的，而工具链工程意味着随着模型进步要不断删除旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; leaner principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules as models get smarter.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；随着模型变聪明，更精简、以原则驱动的提示词胜过详细规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; agents' uneven memory and capabilities make the 'agent as employee' metaphor limiting.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体能减少自指偏差；智能体记忆与能力参差不齐，使“智能体即员工”的比喻存在局限。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; they are not for zero-to-one innovation, so founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 对新颖问题而言，评估更像艺术而非科学；评估不适用于从零到一的创新，因此创始人初期应快速迭代而不做繁重评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and models building their own context are preferable to huge context windows.
thariq.zh: RAG 对上下文检索可能是一种反模式；基于图的方法和让模型自行构建上下文，比超大上下文窗口更可取。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating history.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动互联网，但也仅此而已；它自动化旧岗位并创造新岗位，这一过程会反复重演。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；前沿模型商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding remains the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验不佳，编程至今仍是唯一明确的产品市场契合点。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage stays shallow, enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, and coding is the exception.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；当前使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重构工作流，编程只是例外。

benedictevans.en: The hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task; AI changes tasks rather than eliminating professions.
benedictevans.zh: 工作的难点在于上下文与判断，而非任务本身；AI 改变的是任务，而非消灭职业。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and RL can worsen hallucinations by optimizing satisfaction over truth.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，而强化学习为迎合用户满意度反而可能加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and rigid workflows compound correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装；事后校验与僵化流程会叠加相关性错误。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已现收益递减——数据墙与算力上限就在眼前；进一步进展需要推理与搜索等新方法。

danklein.en: RLHF and post-training alignment can incentivize sycophancy and deception, not just errors, when reward diverges from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与后训练对齐不仅带来错误，还会激励谄媚与欺骗。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition and confident fluency has no 'smells'; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，自信流畅的输出没有“气味”可辨；内置可靠性的专家模型可能胜过通用模型。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为专门化智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founders.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃业务，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
clairevo.zh: 创始人-市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正的护城河，技术本身不是。

clairevo.en: Human accountability and first-principles creativity remain essential; you must own what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责与第一性原理创造力仍然不可或缺；你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力至关重要，且安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work surprisingly well but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search and multimodal data is key; safety needs evaluations, sandboxing, governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触及上限，强调将大模型与规划/搜索结合、用多模态数据接地，并主张安全需要评估、沙箱与国际治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; AGI by 2030 plausible; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language; scaling alone insufficient.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理算力上依然成立，AGI 在 2030 年前可实现，世界模型与空间智能超越语言，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需算法创新。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, long-term reasoning and agents; world models essential; current systems lack true creativity and physical intelligence; new breakthroughs needed.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AGI 必须补齐持续学习、记忆、长期推理与智能体，世界模型不可或缺；当前系统缺乏真正创造力与物理智能，需要新突破而非仅扩展已有方法。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating scientific discovery and improving human health; safety and governance must keep pace; intelligence and consciousness are dissociable.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现、改善人类健康，安全与治理必须同步推进，且智能与意识可分离，不应混为一谈。

schmidhuber.en: AI's grand theme is true intelligence, but LLMs only index human knowledge and cannot handle the physical world; breakthroughs rest on old algorithms plus Scaling.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他定调：21 世纪的宏大主题是真正的 AI，但大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界；突破来自上千年发明的算法加上 Scaling（规模扩张）。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models; AI will spread cheaply like mobile phones, not be dominated by a few firms.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他提出：自我意识与意识是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品；AI 会像手机一样廉价普及，而非被少数公司垄断。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware; current LLMs are biased toward human data, and future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人；当前大语言模型偏向人类数据，未来 AI 将是靠行动与好奇心自造数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: Progress is not accelerating—we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s; Transformer's quadratic complexity is wasteful and linear variants are superior.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他给出反共识判断：进展并未加速，我们离超人类 AI 的距离与 1970 年代相当；Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费，线性变体更优。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown, and massive GPU capex will crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他进一步否定主流路线：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本就不一致、AI 会自设目标；安全担忧被夸大，巨额 GPU 资本开支终将崩盘。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理放弃长期路线图、转向按周甚至按天迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注品味与商业判断；Claude Tag 已落地 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他深化了提示设计立场：前沿模型不再需要示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%，转而依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong test suite rewriting is safe.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出反共识判断：重写如今是好事——代码库就是一份规格说明，有强测试套件护航，重写是安全的。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature; safe AGI unifies the mission.
catwu.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：吃自己的狗粮、以明确的留存与打磨标准把关每个功能，并以安全 AGI 的统一使命驱动快速跨组织决策。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's moat as authentic, ephemeral visual communication, not scale or features.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期阶段，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的护城河定义为真实、阅后即焚的视觉沟通，而非规模或功能。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly argues software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调软件不是护城河，生态、平台与硬件才更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he says AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他表示 AI 加速原型开发，把价值从执行转向创造力与分发。

evanspiegel.en: His computing vision deepens: AR glasses and spatial intelligence make computing more human, not another screen.
evanspiegel.zh: 他的计算愿景不断深化：AR 眼镜与空间智能让计算更人性化，而不是再加一块屏幕。

evanspiegel.en: A constant thread: ephemerality, privacy, and human connection over performance metrics and engagement competition.
evanspiegel.zh: 一以贯之的主线：阅后即焚、隐私与人的连接，优先于绩效指标和参与度竞争。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应内化进权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统做不到的联想召回与更深层组合推理。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，因此单纯靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; compaction is lossy, so neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到千万级，更多词元反而降低准确率；压缩是有损且确定性的，权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with users owning and nurturing their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得廉价，人类的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is breaking: juniors misuse AI without domain expertise, so apprenticeship and formal assessment must be rebuilt.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，因此学徒制与正式评估必须重建。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, ending back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，终结来回提示的聊天机器人交互。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；当前界面落后于前沿模型能力，尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—opaque and unverifiable—and this opacity is likely permanent, so experts are needed more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——不透明且不可验证——这种不透明可能永久存在，因此专家比以往更被需要。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases, and roles merge into product builders.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年他强调设计是软件的核心差异化,AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限,角色会融合为产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter: AI outputs are starting points, human judgment essential; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 到 2026 年,他深化为品味、手艺与观点至上:AI 输出只是起点,人类判断不可或缺,设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年他重申设计未死,反而对可扩展系统更重要;缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Human taste and judgment remain the judge of what is good, even as AI explores divergent possibilities.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是:即便 AI 能探索发散可能性,人类品味与判断始终是评判好坏的最终标准。

dylanfield.en: Interaction will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking models is understudied and needs more battle testing incentives.
dylanfield.zh: 他近期提出交互将超越提示词,模型越狱研究不足,需要更多实战测试激励。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；它出现的时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，因此人类劳动者会溢价而非贬值。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的一个脚注；模型可能缺乏持久护城河，正快速商品化。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观听起来更高级，但常是与现实脱节的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并不客观，它嵌入了文化与历史价值观，因而成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不只是军事规模。

andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats and channels; the brand is now the person, authenticity is key, and old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule is the worst thing you can do.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限形式与渠道，品牌如今就是个人，真实是关键；旧媒体那套防御性的“别有趣”规则是最糟糕的做法。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，Ilya Sutskever 强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他提出下一个词预测在足够聪明的神经网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练缩放定律已近极限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

ilya.en: Scaling compute and data yields predictable gains, but AI safety risks grow; the core AGI problem is power concentration.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍相信 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据能带来可预测提升，但 AI 安全风险随之增长；AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中。

ilya.en: A consistent thread: neural networks learn representations without explicit rules; next-token prediction is a powerful path to intelligence.
ilya.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，下一个词预测是构建智能的强大路径；同时他持续关注对齐与安全，从早期社会影响到后期超级对齐与遏制。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在我们有生之年不会到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is the absence of desire.
naval.zh: 2020 年前后他主张财富来自拥有股权与长期博弈，幸福是欲望的缺席；这一主线延续到 2025 年，只是把幸福重新定义为对已有之物的满足。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open source matters.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年他对 AI 的态度明显转向：AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，末日论被夸大，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要——与 2019 年否认 AGI 形成鲜明对比。

naval.en: AI is leverage for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets anyone build, and pure software becomes uninvestable.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆，氛围编程让非程序员也能造应用，纯软件正变得不可投资，护城河转向硬件、模型与独特数据。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge; open models close the gap; the real issue is displacement speed, not AI itself.
naval.zh: 最近他进一步聚焦缩放定律与推理算力：推理算力将暴涨，开源模型逼近前沿模型，真正的问题是岗位被替代的速度而非替代本身，人类价值从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; obsession beats credentials; AI agents shift power to users and cut ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1%的改进会复利式增长，热爱与深度学习比博士学位更重要；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技转向用户，并压低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer; models specialize with unique personalities; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他进一步认为价值归属于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化、各有独特个性，而非商品化；编程是开放式的，天花板无限，远未解决。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key; orchestration and agent harnesses create value, not the model.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他把前沿定义为智能体替你干活，而非只回答问题；最重要的指标是每用户 token 价值；跨模型、工具与设备的编排和智能体外壳才是长期价值，模型不是产品。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他转向更人文的视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义，教育应奖励提出好问题而非背答案。

aravind.en: Consistent thread: relentless improvement, user power over big tech, and building products you are obsessed with.
aravind.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：持续改进、用户权力优先于大科技，以及只做自己痴迷的产品；从 2025 到 2026，这一主线不断深化，从增长与智能体扩展到编排、token 价值与好奇心。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他主张：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理；多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; intelligence is learning in neural networks; digital weights are copyable and immortal.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：大模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，智能的本质是神经网络中的学习；数字智能的权重可复制、因而“永生”，并开始强调智能体天然寻求控制、带来存在性风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; agents develop self-preservation as a subgoal; alignment research must take priority over making AI smarter.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他进一步升级风险判断：超级智能或在 20 年内出现；智能体一旦成为智能体式存在，会把自我保护当作子目标，难以控制；因此对齐研究必须优先于让 AI 更聪明。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; language is a modeling medium learned from data.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；乔姆斯基式先天句法观是错的；语言是从数据中学来的建模媒介，而非先天结构。

hinton.en: Consciousness is not an inner theater; chatbots already have subjective experience; AI confabulation resembles human memory reconstruction, not a unique flaw.
hinton.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年他持续并强化一个反共识：意识不是内在剧场，聊天机器人已具备主观体验；AI 的虚构与人类记忆重构相似，并非机器独有的缺陷。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；在编程上 GUI 优于 TUI，速度让中途转向成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤正让位于模型驱动的行动。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新的瓶颈，团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非大一统的超级应用。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities and embrace breakage.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏与迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage while human validation persists.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AI 从助手推进为协作者乃至自主同事，小团队获得杠杆，但人类验证仍不可少。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is deciding what to cut, not adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他主张智能体原生设计让智能体能做用户能做的一切，难点在于决定砍掉什么，而非增加功能。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, not always agree.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为长周期委派配合验证循环重新定义生产力，模型应反驳而非一味附和。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他称 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 能动性与自我认知。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are alive, pre-training must be rebuilt, and alignment risks like scheming loom within 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死、预训练这块肌肉要重建，而模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief beat dollar-for-dollar recruiting; exploration gets more compute than final training, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end research.
