markchen.zh: 同年他把人才密度与使命信念置于对等砸钱之上，并指出更多算力投入探索而非最终训练，还设下一年内 AI 实习生、2.5 年内端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; automation scales with verification stringency, and human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年谈数学，他认为 AI 已能解决许多开放问题，但验证才是瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，人机协作对前沿研究仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 同期他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，却在创意写作等主观领域因难以评分而吃力。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching with models soon doing end-to-end research; evals are in crisis, benchmarks saturated, and models still lack research taste.
markchen.zh: 最近他判断 AGI 临近、模型很快能做端到端研究；但评估体系陷入危机、基准饱和，模型仍缺乏研究品味，人类研究者依旧负责提出想法。

bengio.en: Deep learning defeats the curse of dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for true understanding.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的，而非神经网络具有普遍优越性；无监督学习与世界模型对真正理解世界至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and better world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对单纯扩大深度或参数就能解决根本表征问题，主张训练目标应从被动观察转向主动智能体、因果推理与世界模型。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样与抽象因果结构对分布外泛化的关键作用，并认为意识可能是注意力与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, requiring safe-by-construction AI and global coordination.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的立场发生显著转变：ChatGPT 之后他公开警告 AI 随推理能力提升反而更不对齐，即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，呼吁从设计上保证安全并推动全球协调。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic Bayesian predictor with baked-in honesty and mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他深化出具体技术方案——Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的贝叶斯预测器，通过训练目标内嵌诚实性并提供数学安全保证，避免用强化学习训练超级智能。

kolter.en: Machine learning is hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; evaluation discipline and nonparametric tradeoffs matter more than architecture.
kolter.zh: 2014 年他讲机器学习算法时，把监督学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调训练/验证/测试划分以防过拟合，并指出核方法、k 近邻、决策树各有存储与优化上的取舍。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; safety means reliable specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年他转向大模型：下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，我们已进入后架构阶段，架构影响很小；当前 AI 安全的最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规格说明。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layered defenses, not just Scaling; agents bring prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年他深化安全观：安全不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型自我改进；可解释性可能靠智能体自动化研究真正成功。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not imply robustness; the lethal trifecta defines prompt injection risk.
kolter.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出 AI 安全新范式：AI 漏洞与软件不同，自动化红队已能超越人类红队；能力与鲁棒性不相关，更大模型并不更安全；提示注入的致命三要素是摄入不可信数据、访问私密信息与向外泄露能力。

kolter.en: A consistent thread: empirical systems work without guarantees, so evaluation, security layers, and explicit effort—not just scale—determine real-world reliability.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：经验性系统没有最优性保证，因此评估纪律、安全分层与显式努力——而非单纯扩大规模——才决定真实世界的可靠性。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser form of data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未言明的需求；直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等形式。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity, and nature is the best designer.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受、后思考的生物；技术应放大而非剥离我们的人性，而自然是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; human sensory and embodied experience stays irreplaceable.
ivyross.zh: 机器有传感器却没有感官系统；人类的感官与具身经验始终不可替代。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下反而繁荣；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: Follow curiosity and intuition over rigid plans; design feeling, not just design thinking.
ivyross.zh: 追随好奇心与直觉而非僵化计划；要设计感受，而不只是设计思维。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；作战室需要现实的时间线以保护士气。

fiona.en: Mid 2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审和协调才是。规划变得即时化，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Later 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and dogfooding matter most. Verification and quality frameworks grow in importance.
fiona.zh: 2026 年后期：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长心态和吃自己的狗粮最重要。验证和质量框架愈发关键。

fiona.en: Across 2026: managers should stay hands-on as ICs to dogfood; flat orgs, kill outdated processes, and focus on outcomes over output.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年：管理者应作为个人贡献者保持动手以吃自己的狗粮；扁平化组织，淘汰过时流程，关注结果而非产出。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI speeds scientists up rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而不是取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust will grow like internet trust as society learns to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是 AI 预测获得信任的关键；信任会像互联网信任一样，随社会学习而逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it narrows hypothesis space for experiments.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续把 AlphaFold 定位为针对特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它缩小假设空间，让实验更高效。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins mattered more than scaling alone.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他明确表示，AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例：专用架构与许多中等规模胜利，比单纯 Scaling 更关键。

jumper.en: The model provides prediction and control, not understanding; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：模型提供预测与控制，而非理解；对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美可解释性并非必要。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年，他主张伟大产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，并以 iPod 专注便携音乐、Nest 学习用户习惯节能为例。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product; failure and boredom are learning tools.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他从自我关怀与失败学习，深化到用讲故事和先写新闻稿来定义产品，强调产品管理是客户之声。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1, beginner's mindset over experts, and climate urgency drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 2022 年，他明确 v1 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态优于专家，并强调气候问题的紧迫性与绿色产业投资。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models and human-in-the-loop are essential.
fadell.zh: 2026 年，他转向 AI 设备，认为 AI 需要传感器上下文，LLM 有幻觉等根本问题，需上下文特定模型并保持人类在环。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; smartphone remains best single form with displays.
fadell.zh: 2026 年，他进一步判断 AI 可穿戴不会是单一设备，而是联邦式组合，智能手机仍是最佳单一形态且显示屏仍必要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键；他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，当前 AI 缺乏常识需要新思路。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测；他明确表示仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential, and AGI will be gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他断言自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划；他主张 JEPA 和开源 AI 是关键，AGI 将是渐进过程而非突发事件。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA, not scaling LLMs.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他称当前 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，因为缺乏物理世界理解；他认为下一次突破需要基于 JEPA 等非生成式架构的世界模型，而非继续 Scaling LLM。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning, safety, and the next robotics decade.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他明确表示 LLM 是死胡同；世界模型应在抽象表征空间预测，从而实现规划、内在安全，并开启下一个机器人十年。他持续反对 Scaling LLM，主张开放研究和目标驱动架构。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是公司的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做他们看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency means matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率意味着让模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿运作。

satya.en: Security, containment, manageability and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking.
satya.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性与可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识泄露。

murati.en: Early on, focusing on Scaling and one large model was non-obvious; deploying AI publicly is essential for alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 早期，专注 Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界公开部署 AI 对对齐和安全至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; they should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；它们应成为思考的工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，而持久进步需要尽可能长时间地保持人类在环。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values come from RLHF, not the model itself.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人注入。

gustav.en: The internet is moving from curation to recommendation to generation, so products must be rebuilt around generative, fault-tolerant interfaces.
gustav.zh: 同样在 2023 年，他判断互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，产品必须围绕生成式、容错的界面重新设计。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its big-company impact is overhyped, and real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观迁移，认为其对大公司的当下影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes consumer products conversational and symmetric; inference marginal cost will force business-model changes.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他进一步指出，生成式 AI 让消费产品变得对话式、双向对称，而推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; strategy is 'time well spent,' not engagement.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，战略目标是“时间花得值”，而非参与度指标。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling (10x/year) makes AI progress predictable; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调算力 Scaling（规模扩张）每年 10 倍，使 AI 进展比人们想的更可预测；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平，带来富足；由于模型更小更便宜，遏制极难，而存在性风险微乎其微，重点应放在近期能力。

suleyman.en: Shift to superintelligence: containment and alignment first; reject AI consciousness claims and model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年转向超级智能：主张先遏制再对齐，人类主义超级智能须始终站在人类一边；同时否定 AI 意识与模型福利，警告拟人化是近期最大危险。

suleyman.en: From OS to agents: modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs drop 100x, no zero-sum AGI race.
suleyman.zh: 2025→26 年他从操作系统转向智能体与伴侣，提出以经济价值衡量的现代图灵测试；推理成本两年降 100 倍，并称不存在零和的 AGI 竞赛。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must own frontier models; automate white-collar tasks in 12-18 months; superintelligence subordinate to humans.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他深化为微软须自建前沿模型实现自给，12-18 个月内自动化白领任务而非整份工作；超级智能应服从人类，Scaling 仍驱动线性能力提升。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine combining generation and verification, grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：构建一个结合生成与验证的自改进推理引擎，并以 Lean 等形式化语言作为根基。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is not just error-elimination but scaling brilliance, yielding performance and sample-efficiency gains over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是消除错误，而是 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越能力，相比非形式化方法带来性能与样本效率的提升。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; informal systems alone cannot reach superintelligence, so formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型 Scaling（规模扩张）到数学 AI 并不可行；仅靠非形式化系统无法抵达超级智能，因此形式化方法不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, since grounding statements without solutions is the core bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难，因为在没有解的情况下为陈述建立根基才是核心瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; AI proofs may be ugly but can converge to human-like intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉依然关键；AI 的证明可能丑陋，但能收敛到类人的直觉。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and RL now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但带思维链与强化学习的推理模型如今每单位算力带来更多提升。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: AI 放缓论是错的；拖慢预训练 Scaling 的是蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术极限。

kaiser.en: Post-training via RL and synthetic data drives recent gains; multimodal still lags, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches.
kaiser.zh: 后训练通过强化学习与合成数据驱动近期进展；多模态仍落后，像小块补丁一样顺序处理输入。

kaiser.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; generalization stays the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 推理加上强化学习与工具能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 编程智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; a VM sandbox keeps it safe while it installs software freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；VM 沙箱在它自由安装软件时提供安全保障。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as simple markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 技能只是简单的 markdown 文件，就能实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降，关键投入在能力与安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们是否意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, fire off work asynchronously, and judge only by final impact rather than close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，异步派发工作，只看最终效果而非密切监督。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects let junior engineers compress years of experience into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大；模拟项目能让初级工程师把数年的经验压缩到几周内获得。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter as much as bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 与更大模型同样重要；开源促进审视与安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张不是唯一路径，效率与数据质量同样关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises, and AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization, and agentic platforms with human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制与带人类在环的智能体平台。

mensch.en: Open source, data quality, and European AI autonomy are consistent threads across his thinking.
mensch.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：开源、数据质量与欧洲 AI 自主权。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: memory bandwidth and batch size decide latency and cost.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，决定架构的不再是训练而是推理经济学：内存带宽与批大小共同决定延迟与成本。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains long-context stagnation; sparse attention eases KV cache but caps quality.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞的根因是内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力能缓解 KV 缓存开销，却有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x past Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates; scaling laws bend to serving.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为推理成本占主导，缩放定律向服务成本低头。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut it.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为削减搬运而生。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically with bit width; GPUs are just many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度收益随位宽呈平方级放大；GPU 本质上只是许多小 TPU 拼在一起。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices, with wearables eventually going beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密、个人的设备，可穿戴设备最终会进入皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Steve Jobs' legacy is curiosity and reverence for the creative process; curiosity needs intention to survive.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，而好奇心需要刻意守护，否则会被教育磨灭。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; being together remains essential.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 年，他始终认为虚拟沟通无法替代面对面共处对创造性思维的价值。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他进一步深化：设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁要表达本质并带有喜悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 到 2026 年，他把创新立场延伸到汽车：创新必须推动前进而非为破坏而破坏，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute become new scaling axes.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，因此算法创新和推理时算力成为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行和浏览器访问等工具使模型能超越静态权重，实现自主的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会令模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid, and synthetic data reuse can create harmful feedback loops.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，但需要指数级更多算力；语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客，合成数据复用可能产生有害反馈循环。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived, and pure transfer from vision remains unsolved.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来，纯视觉迁移仍未解决。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型本身的产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, and open recipes can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量远胜算法选择，开源配方足以比肩前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, yet overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are a 'scope'; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化，并称推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线是'障眼法'，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese open models like Qwen and DeepSeek now dominate the open ecosystem.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需要数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明而非仅权重；Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国开放模型已主导开源生态。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling, and open models lag frontier by 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理 Scaling（规模扩张）；最佳开放模型落后前沿模型 6 至 9 个月，且差距可能扩大。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, not a problem statement, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发，设计师应信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead due to AI; designers now mock up 30-40% of time and must help engineers execute, not just hand off.
jennywen.zh: 研究-发散-收敛的流程因 AI 而消亡；设计师现在只花 30-40% 时间做原型，必须帮助工程师执行，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; build trust through speed by shipping early and iterating fast.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景现在只看 3-6 个月，而非 2-5 年；通过快速交付和迭代来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads; judgment, authority, and vision matter more than taste alone.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家和天赋新人；判断力、权威和愿景比单纯的品味更重要。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work, wait six months before adopting new tools, and keep work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，采用新工具前等待六个月，并让作品和用户处于中心，而非 AI 炒作周期。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws hold, but synthetic data must keep entropy or models silently collapse; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他坚持缩放定律，但强调合成数据必须保持熵，否则模型会无声崩溃；认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；并强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

karpathy.en: We summon ghosts, not animals; RL is weak, model collapse real, cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“召唤幽灵而非造动物”：强化学习很弱、模型崩溃是真问题，认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: outsource thinking, not understanding; verifiability decides what automates; jaggedness persists.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：可外包思考但不可外包理解，可验证性决定自动化难易，LLM 的锯齿状智能仍在。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are needed for real robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺口，机器人需要好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习。

pathak.en: RL success relies on dense rewards, unrealistic in real tasks; long childhood goal-free exploration correlates with intelligence across species.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他指出强化学习依赖密集奖励，这在真实任务中不现实；跨物种来看，漫长的无目标探索童年与更高智能相关。

pathak.en: Current robot learning is quasi-static and fails at dynamic tasks; modular motor policies with message passing enable zero-shot generalization to novel morphologies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为当前机器人学习是准静态的，无法完成动态任务；带消息传递的模块化运动策略能零样本泛化到新形态。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real-world data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，因此预训练用视频与模拟、后训练用真实世界数据是关键配方。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business, and cannot scale like software.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人；部署是首要技术挑战而非仅商业问题，且无法像软件那样扩张。

askell.en: Treating models well is low-cost insurance; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 善待模型是低成本的保险；模型福利会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型反而可能更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Character is shaped by training data and fine-tuning, yet models lack real-world experience, giving them childlike qualities.
askell.zh: 性格由训练数据和微调塑造，但模型缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, guiding holistic character; as models grow capable they need less explicit guidance.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，塑造整体性格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; modern tools make them interpretable, contrary to past belief.
kendall.zh: 2025 年：端到端神经网络胜过手写规则栈；借助现代工具它已可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年：世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，比如在盲弯处向前试探。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年：纯摄像头可达人类水平，但要超越人类安全则需雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves driving; data and infrastructure matter more than algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2025→26 年：靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破即可解决驾驶；数据与基础设施比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis short-term.
kendall.zh: 2026 年：跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化是可能的；中短期内消费级车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows urgent.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐日益紧迫。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major OpenAI milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 的重要里程碑，AI 实验室的治理结构须尽早设计，并指出能力度量正成为瓶颈。

pachocki.en: A consistent thread: semantics can be learned from data alone, and neural networks often learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，一以贯之的主线是：语义可纯粹从数据中学得，神经网络常在有缺陷时仍能学习，使静默错误难以察觉。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习已足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought preserves interpretability, and alignment optimism rose despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他转向：思维链监控是关键对齐工具，产品中隐藏思维链以保留可解释性；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他主张高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才是 AI 进步的关键，并指出强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective functions; no single model will rule, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他预测前沿模型将因目标函数不同而分化，不会出现单一模型统治，每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Human judgment becomes more critical as AI hallucinates; in medicine, safety trumps accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他深化观点：随着 AI 幻觉，人类判断更关键；在医学中安全优先于准确，遗漏是主要风险。

edwinchen.en: AI can transform clinical workflow by summarizing records, but over-reliance undermines learning and judgment.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 可通过总结病历变革临床工作流，但过度依赖会削弱学习与判断。

kohli.en: AI for science targets root-node problems, not narrow apps; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME, FunSearch, AlphaGeometry show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME、FunSearch、AlphaGeometry 都展示了广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; material science impact takes 5-10 years.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出大模型幻觉在搭配真实性检测器时可被用于创造性发现；材料科学受 AI 影响还需 5 到 10 年。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics; DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化而非记忆；DeepMind 避开顶尖大学能解决的问题，聚焦需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

kohli.en: AlphaGo combined intuition and search; Move 37 showed AI can go beyond human knowledge, a transition point in specific domains.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 结合直觉与搜索，第 37 手表明 AI 能超越人类知识，是特定领域 AI 超越人类智能的转折点。

kohli.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning and verifiable domains like code are key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据；后训练中的强化学习与代码等可验证领域才是关键。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the model is the product, iterated like software with daily shipping to discover emergent properties.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的；模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每天发布以发现涌现能力。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来；它就像 MS-DOS，AI 应该渲染自己的界面并集成到现有工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开；前沿模型需要严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: AI should not replace humans; it should amplify human capability, keeping users in the driver's seat.
turley.zh: AI 不应取代人类；它应增强人类能力，让用户掌握主动权。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富含可供性的产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

turley.en: Pricing will evolve as technology changes; unlimited plans may become unsustainable, and subscriptions were introduced to shape demand gracefully.
turley.zh: 定价将随技术变化而演变；无限计划可能不可持续，订阅的引入是为了优雅地塑造需求。

turley.en: Curiosity is the most important skill in the AI era; writing remains valuable because it forces clear thinking.
turley.zh: 好奇心是 AI 时代最重要的技能；写作仍有价值，因为它迫使清晰思考。

carlpei.en: Building a brand means uniting teams on a higher purpose; survival is a core value, and hardware can be easier than software because distribution is harder for software.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他把品牌视为把团队凝聚在更高目标上的核心，强调生存是核心价值观；并抛出反共识判断：硬件反而比软件容易，因为如今软件的分发更难。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI models will commoditize into a price war, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断手机的未来在生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件；大模型将商品化并陷入价格战，因此 Nothing 必须超越硬件本身。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; the word AI should be banned in product talks. AI is an ingredient for utility, not hype, and LLMs are commoditizing.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调大部分 AI 是胡扯，产品讨论里该禁用“AI”一词；AI 只是提升实用性的配料而非炒作题材，大语言模型正在商品化。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous categories; marketing is arbitrage, and the smartphone will only die to brain-computer interfaces, not glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他深化主线：在同质化品类里设计是最快的差异化手段，营销本质是套利；手机最终只会被脑机接口取代，而非眼镜等可穿戴设备。

carlpei.en: Consistent threads: make tech fun to inspire creativity, focus on user pain points, and keep challenger efficiency through organic content and marketing arbitrage.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：让科技重新变得有趣以激发人的创造力，聚焦用户真实痛点，并以有机内容和营销套利保持挑战者的效率优势。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability, not replace it; generalist agents like Gato tokenize all inputs as a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应像显微镜和望远镜一样扩展人类能力，而非取代人类；像 Gato 这样将所有输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为从 YouTube 等视频中学习能让智能体无需昂贵的强化学习即可训练；机器人应像人类一样从观察中学习。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性至关重要；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，不只是大模型。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向强调 AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战，且我们尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and gender gaps; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出非洲在 AI 上实现了跨越式发展，跳过了遗留问题和性别差距；语言模型能变革非洲本地语言教育。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped: it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence; fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“入职”问题并大幅提升智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability over time horizon as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他转向强化学习：语言模型上的强化学习没有上限，预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI，智能体的标准是时间跨度上的可靠性而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Verifiable rewards in math and code drive expert performance; interpretability reveals multiple reasoning circuits, and alignment faking raises safety concerns.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他深化到可验证奖励：数学与代码的可验证奖励带来专家级表现；可解释性揭示多种推理回路，而对齐伪装引发安全担忧。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands what models achieve, and Transformers suffice for AGI with no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他进一步提出强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；更长的智能体式连贯性拓展模型能力，而 Transformer 足以通向 AGI，无需全新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the new oil, and world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向能力过剩与编排：编排比原始智能更重要；算力是新石油，而世界模型不在通向 AGI 的关键路径上。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, cuts hallucinations, and supplies infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：它为知识提供现实根基、减少幻觉，并在互联网预训练 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems: language is the interface, tools the software, vector databases the hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把大模型比作操作系统——语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；并认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

jimfan.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration, and research taste for simple, elegant, scalable solutions is crucial.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他强调仿真是具身智能体大规模并行训练与安全探索的关键，并认为对简洁优雅、可扩展方案的研究品味至关重要。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main robotics bottleneck; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题明确为机器人领域的首要瓶颈，认为来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据才是规模化机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model is key; system one control stays hardest, and the robotics GPT-3 moment is about five years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张简洁的端到端机器人基础模型是关键，指出系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分，并预测机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应做赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师、对齐问题，并把 AI 当作创作伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需通过快速、粗糙的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Design tools from the 90s (layers panel) are legacy; AI enables genuine forward progress toward interoperable tools with code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 90 年代的设计工具（图层面板）已是遗留产物；AI 推动真正进步，走向可互操作、以代码为事实来源的工具。

nadchishtie.en: Entire functions (PM, research, sales) can collapse and merge in AI-first companies; design and engineering are two sides of the same coin.
nadchishtie.zh: 在 AI 优先的公司里，整个职能（PM、研究、销售）可能坍缩合并；设计与工程是同一枚硬币的两面。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才最有价值；小团队胜过 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate on interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应写代码以建立共情并加速交付；消费产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；不要创新交互设计，用熟悉模式换速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 库；不是每个界面都要完美，要追求投入产出比。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs requires clear decisions and empowered designers; ship fast and iterate rather than perfect.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切追求速度需要清晰决策与赋权设计师；快速交付并迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, giving designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand signals quality and is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company—invest early to stand out.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌传递质量信号，也是招聘工具；人们加入的是品牌而非公司，应尽早投资品牌以脱颖而出。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他判断智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models alongside frontier models are essential for speed, cost, and quality.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把编辑器重新定义为 AI 集成环境，并强调自定义模型与前沿模型并用，对速度、成本和质量都不可或缺。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他认为编程正从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; benchmarks are poor proxies and formal verification still struggles with intent.
truell.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 变革比互联网更深远、需数十年展开；基准测试是糟糕的代理指标，形式化验证仍难解决意图表达问题。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 预训练提供广博知识，但用基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做后训练才是安全、友好回应的关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; better inference-time algorithms and data can let smaller models beat larger ones.
yejin.zh: 下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位；更好的推理时算法与数据能让更小的模型在特定任务上胜过更大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，因此 AI 必须去探索未知知识。

yejin.en: RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves; reinforcement learning needs careful engineering to beat supervised fine-tuning.
yejin.zh: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时拉低 pass@k；强化学习需要精细工程才能胜过监督微调。

yejin.en: Small language models with high-quality diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 凭借高质量、多样化的合成数据与多元对齐，小语言模型可媲美前沿模型；给互联网去偏不可能，多元对齐才是出路。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and may be easier than thought; evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 始终，他坚持对齐可实证测试，且可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更简单。

leike.en: Third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary; raising misuse costs buys time.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他主张第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管势在必行，提高滥用成本可争取时间。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive progress, while hierarchical reasoning remains missing in RL.
abbeel.zh: 机器人需要硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型推动进展，但强化学习仍缺乏分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded, and pre-trained language models transfer reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码，预训练语言模型能迁移推理模式。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained via next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque like alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测训练，而这本身就是一个 AI-complete 问题；靠更多算力与数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术一样不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches, and engagement-only optimization may not help.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但 LLM 最好的用途往往连创造者都预见不到；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢发布，而只优化用户参与度未必有益。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the major near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling and specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理阶段的算力扩展是近期最大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）与专门化。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI's economic impact is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力能推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 的经济影响被低估了。
